description: This file defines functions for managing pane layouts and transitions within a web application, particularly for different device screens (tablet, mobile, etc.). It includes functions to determine pane configurations based on layout and device type, as well as functions to compare previous and current pane states.

methods.name: export function panesForLayout(layout: PaneLayout, application: WebApplication): AppPaneId[] { panesForLayout
methods.description: Determines the set of panes to display based on the current layout and device screen type.

methods.description: Checks if the pane configuration change is a leaf dismiss (removing the last pane).

methods.name: export function isPanesChangePush(from: AppPaneId[], to: AppPaneId[]): boolean { isPanesChangePush
methods.description: Checks if the pane configuration change is a push (adding or changing panes beyond the last one).
